descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S22 Device-local copies of cleared data are gone too (web storage, native app storage)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U11 Live patient data never survives past its window: once an item clears, no copy of it remains anywhere live (other fields of the chart, dated histories, the patient-list row, handoffs, drafts). … (UAT OAT-04 Expected 2; UAT 3.7 (retention claim)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Debug iOS and Android builds and the web app pointed at the local stack (Convex 4510, Vite 6473), one fresh @roundai.test account from freshAccount(); never the TestFlight / Play build, never the store-review fixed-code account. Each device used to dictate pre-round text and record vitals for a patient; …

When Inspect the app's local storage (web: localStorage / IndexedDB; native: app preferences and files) and reopen the app offline

Then No copy of the cleared values remains on the device or shows while offline

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-04 Expected 2. Whether device recovery drafts count as live data is Q6 (TFA-94745 left 'PHI at rest' open): a cleared value found on the device = Fail if device copies count, otherwise reported for Daniela

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev.

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S22

Device-local copies of cleared data are gone too (web storage, native app storage)

Tickets: TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

Skipped — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14): iOS and Android are left out, and the native half reads the app's storage on iOS and Android debug builds.
